designs.name: Bram
designs.description: An elderly lighthouse keeper in his seventies with a gravelly, salt-worn voice. Slow, kind and a little grumpy, with a soft Scottish lilt. Recorded close, warm and clear.
designs.text: Forty years I've kept this light, and every night the sea tells me a new story. Tonight it says a storm is coming, so put the kettle on and stay in.

designs.name: Tik
designs.description: A tiny, curious wind-up robot with a bright, slightly metallic and buzzy voice. Speaks fast and excitedly, like a child seeing snow for the first time.
designs.text: Hello, hello! I am Tik, assistant sound engineer, and I have pressed every button in the studio. Every single one. Is that smoke? That is probably fine!

designs.name: Velvet
designs.description: A breathy, low female late-night jazz announcer. Smooth, unhurried and intimate, as if smiling into a vintage ribbon microphone.
designs.text: It's two in the morning, the saxophone is tired, and so are you. Lean back, darling. This next one is for everyone still awake and pretending not to be.

designs.name: Nimbus
designs.description: A sleepy giant made of clouds: an extremely deep, soft, slow voice, rumbling like distant thunder, with long yawns between words.
designs.text: Mmm. I was floating over your town just now. Everyone was asleep except you. That's alright. I'll drift a little slower, so you can watch me go by.
